external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A library member using the library service to borrow, renew or reserve books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
external_entities.notes: The sources do not state where members or their phones are located.

external_entities.name: Desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk personnel who handle loan problems and account changes.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login; individual staff members and branches cannot be distinguished in the history.

processes.name: Library app
processes.description: A phone application through which members request loans, renewals and reservations.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: Lending API
processes.description: The REST API that is the sole stated interface for reading or writing loans and serves the circulation page.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: The sources disagree about exposure. Lending service note: "The lending API is internal-only." Interview transcript, Priya: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." Authentication is also unverified: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in" and that she could not say what it accepts or does with a call it does not like.

processes.name: Self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where members scan their library card and books being borrowed or returned.
processes.source_excerpt: Every branch has self-service kiosks where a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning.

data_stores.name: Loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, loans, reservations, contact details and borrowing history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: Priya corrected the earlier description of two databases: "We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone."

data_flows.name: use library app
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to request lending-service actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

data_flows.name: submit loan request
data_flows.description: The library app calls the lending API with member and book or title information for loan, renewal and reservation actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member
data_flows.notes: Authentication is unverified: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."
data_flows.data_description: member and book or title information for loans, renewals and reservations

data_flows.name: send loan or return
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends each scanned loan or return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.notes: The transcript does not establish whether kiosks communicate directly with the loans database; it only states what arrives at the API.
data_flows.data_description: loan and return records from scanned members and books

data_flows.name: change loan record
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: The shared account means the system records only that the desk made the change, not which person or branch.

data_flows.name: read and write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: members, loans, reservations and borrowing history

trust_boundaries.name: Branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks and desk staff operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: Council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre zone where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: Internet
trust_boundaries.description: The network through which phones reach the lending API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing history.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states: "Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database."

assumptions.assumption: The lending API presents a web interface because it is described as a REST API.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states: "It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out." REST is an HTTP-family application interface.
